dct_description_sm: The original publication (see Related Publication) and this data set should both be cited if these data are used; see the original publication for detailed methods.

We compared the vegetation communities and soil seed bank of paired areas invaded and uninvaded by escaped Miscanthus sacchariflorus at 10 sites in Ontario, Canada, to determine the effects of this potentially invasive grass on the resident plant community.
dct_title_s: Effect of escaped, naturalized Miscanthus sacchariflorus on resident vegetation and soil seed bank
